checkpoint.title: Route 4 Center: the Magikarp into BOX 1
notes: The Magikarp goes to BOX 1 at the Center's PC (11, 1), so Mt. Moon is fought with the starter alone (console B, 2026-11-02: done by hand and saved at (11, 2), facing the PC, where this row ends). The wandering boy (4..6, 3..5) is walked around. The Magikarp comes from Gift RNG: with Gift RNG off the party is the starter alone, and the deposit is skipped.

events.why: DEPOSIT the party's second slot into BOX 1, if it has one
